entries.name: gameState
entries.meaning: current game mode (g_GameState): field = 1, battle = 2, world map = 3, menu = 5, motorcycle minigame = 6 (confirmed); the other minigames (7-11, 14) are unlabelled. Reads field during a movie; reads 0 on the title
entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt: g_GameState; values: notes/36-disc-boot.md. Tier 2 (#76, notes/76-confirm-mode.md): 1 at reactor-entrance, after closing the menu and after the first battle; 5 with the menu open; 2 in the first guard battle; 1 during the opening movie; chain of in-memory snapshots from reactor-entrance (#74); determinism = reruns from the same snapshot, not chain vs scratch (#88). Tier 2 (#80, notes/80-boot-catalogue.md): 3 for 690 frames after a generated save loads into the world map outside Kalm and outside Midgar; 6 for 600 frames after one loads into the motorcycle minigame, while its track position advances

entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt: g_PrevGameState; notes/36-disc-boot.md. Tier 2 (#107): 0 at reactor-entrance is a check, not only a metric

entries.name: movieFrame
entries.meaning: frame number of the playing movie (Stframe_no, the streaming library): it advances (15 a second) while a movie plays and holds its last value afterwards (1790 after the opening). It can read 0 on single frames during a movie, so judge over a window: a movie is playing when gameState is field and this value advances
entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt: Stframe_no. Tier 2 (#76): 0 until the opening movie starts, 150 more after 10 s, 1790 at its end and unchanged at reactor-entrance; one 0 read mid-movie (attempt 1). The first candidate, g_MovieLock (0x800716CC), read 0 throughout the opening; chain of in-memory snapshots from reactor-entrance (#74); determinism = reruns from the same snapshot, not chain vs scratch (#88)

entries.name: fieldId
entries.meaning: current location (field ID, g_FieldCurrentMap); documented IDs 0x0000 to 0x0312 (ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID). It changes as soon as the player walks through an exit, before the new field has loaded (see fieldLoading)
entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt and include/game.h: g_FieldCurrentMap. Tier 2 (#77, notes/77-field-position.md): md1stin (0x74) at reactor-entrance, md1_1 (0x75) after walking up-left off it, as the wiki documents; the savemap copy (0x8009C6E4 + 0x0B96) reads the same at md1stin. chain of in-memory snapshots from reactor-entrance (#74); determinism = reruns from the same snapshot, not chain vs scratch (#88)

entries.name: playerModel
entries.meaning: field model index of the player (g_PlayerModelId): the element of fieldX/fieldY that is the player. Only 0 is confirmed (md1stin); another value is a hypothesis until a Tier 2 scenario sees it
entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt: g_PlayerModelId. Tier 2: 0 at md1stin with model 0 the one that moves with the pad (#77, reactor-field-2-still; #38, save-boot-1-load), and 0 at nmkin_1 with model 0 moving under the pad and model 1 still (#99, save-boot-3-player-model-nmkin-1). #99 found no reachable state where it is not 0: Cloud or Barret leading, in md1stin, md1_1, md1_2, nmkin_1, md8_1, mds7st1 and mds7 (notes/99-player-model.md); chain of in-memory snapshots from reactor-entrance (#74); determinism = reruns from the same snapshot, not chain vs scratch (#88)

entries.name: fieldLoading
entries.meaning: field load state (g_IsFieldLoading): 2 in a settled field; another value (1 was seen) while a field loads. The field ID changes first and the load starts later (114 frames later at md1stin -> md1_1), so 2 alone does not mean loaded: a field is loaded when, after the field ID changed, this has left 2 and read 2 again (gameState field)
entries.source: Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173034bde2ae4c9b0312167e79c3645ca1be config/symbols.main.us.txt: g_IsFieldLoading. Tier 2 (#77, notes/77-field-position.md): 2 at md1stin; after walking off to md1_1 it left 2 114 frames after the ID changed and read 2 again 66 frames later, in two runs; chain of in-memory snapshots from reactor-entrance (#74); determinism = reruns from the same snapshot, not chain vs scratch (#88)
